name: ultimatter
description: The Ultimate Mobile Gateway for Antigravity

scripts.build:linux: cargo build --release --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml && strip desktop/target/release/ultimatter && install -m 755 desktop/target/release/ultimatter bin/ultimatter-linux-x64
scripts.build:mac: cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml 2>/dev/null && cp desktop/target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/ultimatter bin/ultimatter-macos-arm64 || npx @yao-pkg/pkg index.js --output bin/ultimatter-macos-arm64 --targets node22-macos-arm64
scripts.build:win: cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu --manifest-path desktop/Cargo.toml 2>/dev/null && cp desktop/target/x86_64-pc-windows-gnu/release/ultimatter.exe bin/ultimatter-windows-x64.exe || npx @yao-pkg/pkg index.js --output bin/ultimatter-windows-x64.exe --targets node22-win-x64
scripts.build:all: npm run build:linux && npm run build:mac && npm run build:win
